_doc: Revert-verify mutants for vault-exodev ems__Bug 0b24c745 (a query constant keeps its base direction; the direction is bound to ITS literal, not to its language) and ems__Bug 97ebe042 (a language-tagged constant is the language-tagged literal; `=` / `!=` compare the language tag and direction of any literal). Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct within the spec). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › <axis> `. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted. Subject: compare: `=` / `!=` against a language-tagged literal also compare its language tag and direction.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/infrastructure/sparql/filters/functions/LogicalFunctions.ts

L1_values_only._note: The language branch never runs — values only (the pre-fix state).
L1_values_only._note_review: Axes added at the specification stage (11.11): T24 — comparing values only makes "x" = "x"@en true.

L2_only_when_both_tagged._note: Plausible wrong fix: the language counts only when BOTH sides carry a tag — a tagged literal still equals the simple literal of its text.
L2_only_when_both_tagged._note_review: Axes added at the specification stage (11.11): T24 — a plain left side is not tagged, so the value comparison makes "x" = "x"@en true.

L3_direction_ignored._note: The key compares the language only — "x"@ar--rtl = "x"@ar.

L4_not_equal_not_negated._note_review: Axes added at the specification stage (11.11): T24 — "x" != "x"@en answers as = and drops both rows.

L5_plain_left_skips_tag._note: Review of the specification (11.11, MU10): the language branch is skipped when only the RIGHT side is tagged and the left is a plain string — "x" = "x"@en became true again.

L6_ordering_operators_take_equality_bran._note: Review of the specification (11.11, MU9): the language branch is entered for every operator but < and > — <= / >= over tagged literals answer as != and the guarantee «< > <= >= stay as they were» breaks.
